Hey! My name is Trevor Somerville and I am working on a new prototype the concept it pretty simple a digital plaque called dPlaque!

 

dPlaque will allow you to send messages from your phone such as:

  • Your name
  • Scrolling and rotating text messages
  • 16 grayscale graphics or other animations
  • Is it cold in here or is it just you? Show the temperature!
  • Out for 30 minutes? Let people know display "Out for Lunch back in 30 minutes" and for bonus points tick down the minutes with a clock graphic.
  • Schedule the on/off time of your dPlaque. Do you really need it on at 3AM? Simple date and time settings let dPlaque get some sleep and extend battery life.

 

For more advance users:

  • Firmware can be updated with a USB cable and Arduino IDE
  • Microcontroller will be the same as Arduino's ATMEGA328
  • Bluetooth chip the same as the Bluno's CC2540
  • Battery pack can be used to power other Arduino projects

 

The USB rechargeable battery will last about a month in an 8 hour a day office setting or about 1 week running 24/7. The display is OLED 5.5 inches 254x64 resolution with each pixel ~0.5mmx0.5mm.

 

Price

With completed molds we hope to manufacture, assemble and sell dPlaques for $90 USD each.

 

The Team Eh!

  • Trevor Somerville, myself. I do electronics PCB design, C and a bit of everything. I have a bachelors in electronics.
